description: Completion of the remaining works of the construction project of a Multi-Ethnic and Trilingual new National School in the Polonnaruwa District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2015-09-09 for the construction of a new multi-ethnic and trilingual national school in the Polonnaruwa District. Under this, it has been planned to construct 02 building complexes as Block 01 and Block 02. The construction of the Block 01 building complex was carried out under the guidance of the High Commission of India as a grant from the Government of India and the construction of the Block 02 building complex was carried out under the guidance of the then Ministry of Education with the funds of the Government of Sri Lanka. In view of the economic crisis which prevailed in the country, the construction of Block 02 building complex has been suspended and the relevant contract has been terminated. The relevant scope of Block 1 has been revised under the guidance of the High Commission of India, and after completion of the ground floor, construction has been carried out up to the roof of the upper floor and steps have been taken to hand over the said building complex to the Government of Sri Lanka on 2025-10-31. The Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau, the consulting engineering firm for the project, has submitted an estimate of Rs.199.13 million for the completion of the remaining works of the Block 01 building complex. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to take necessary steps to complete the works of the said building complex based on the said estimate, was approved by the Cabinet.
